text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey and Hokko Tarumae fought a 
fierce battle. A tempest of thunderous 
applause and warm cheers celebrating her 
comeback arose spontaneously from the 
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then came the discussion about their 
next race. The Trainer was aggressively 
pressed by the two, who were eager to run 
as soon as possible, urging them to make a 
quick decision.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, Wonder Acute declared that she 
wanted to run together next time, too. 
Their next goal was set: all three of them 
entering the JBC Classic together.
